description: Defines the EmployeeLicense entity class for ORM, representing employee licenses with properties like license number, issued and expiry dates, and relations to License and Employee entities.

classes.name: EmployeeLicense
classes.description: Entity class representing an employee's license, including license details and relations to License and Employee entities.

methods.name: getLicense
methods.description: Returns the License associated with this EmployeeLicense.

methods.name: setLicense
methods.description: Sets the License associated with this EmployeeLicense.

methods.name: getLicenseIssuedDate
methods.description: Returns the date the license was issued.

methods.name: setLicenseIssuedDate
methods.description: Sets the date the license was issued.

methods.name: getLicenseExpiryDate
methods.description: Returns the expiry date of the license.

methods.name: setLicenseExpiryDate
methods.description: Sets the expiry date of the license.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee associated with this license.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Sets the Employee associated with this license.
